name: AICTE – Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (GRI) Scheme
benefit:
1. The AICTE-MITACS GRI Program will be jointly funded for 300 students by AICTE & MITACS as per the details below: 

  - The total cost of the program is $12,000 CAD per student. 
  - MITACS will contribute $9,000 CAD per student. 
  - AICTE will contribute $3,000 CAD per student. 

1. The full cost per student includes airfare, visa, medical, stipend, accommodation, Globalink Student Mentors
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a 3rd-year full-time student of an undergraduate program (B.E / B.Tech) in an AICTE-approved institution in the year of application. 1. The applicant must have a minimum CGPA / GPA of 85% in the 2nd year. 1. The applicant must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The applicant must be able to spend twelve (12) weeks between May and September at a university in Canada on a research project related to their area of interest and expertise. 1. The applicant must be able to demonstrate oral and written fluency in English or French, depending on the primary language of the project as indicated by the Canadian host professor.
